params.instr: Compare the disclosed mechanisms and their explicitly stated operating constraints in 150-220 words. Describe what is adjusted, what is preserved, and what remains unverified. Do not infer constraints from unavailable background text.

params.predicate: The excerpt explains a conflict between two technical objectives or constraints: improving one creates a cost or obstacle for the other. Identify an explicit causal conflict, such as compute capacity versus data exposure, temporal detail versus compute budget, or effective drug exposure versus peak-induced side effects. Two unrelated benefits do not qualify. Use only the supplied excerpt; missing or unstated evidence means False.

params.instr: Classify the primary intervention mechanism using exactly one label: FEEDBACK_CONTROL, SIGNAL_INTERPRETATION, RESOURCE_ALLOCATION, STRUCTURAL_CONFIGURATION, MATERIAL_COMPOSITION, PROCESS_SEQUENCE, or OTHER. Prefer FEEDBACK_CONTROL only when observation drives corrective actuation; prefer SIGNAL_INTERPRETATION for diagnosis without correction. Use only the supplied excerpt. Mark unstated fields UNKNOWN; do not invent performance results or claim scope.

params.predicate: The excerpt specifies an operational dependency: an intermediate result is used by a later processing stage, or a stated condition determines an operation or state transition. A static list of components, spatial relationships, or desired benefits alone does not qualify. Use only the supplied excerpt; missing or unstated evidence means False.
